finding: finding 10: /media proxy allowlist location
detail: Section 3 gives the allowlist as an unquoted regex: location ~ ^/media/(products/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/[0-9a-f]{16}-[0-9]{3,4}\.webp)$. nginx treats { and } as block delimiters, so a regex that contains them must be quoted. As written, the rendered default.conf fails nginx -t with a parse error, and the web image would not start. The rollout nginx -t check would catch it, but the spec text itself is wrong. The rest of finding 10 is resolved consistently: query string stripped, 404 for every error, one-header-per-line proxy_hide_header, Cache-Control added without 'always', and dev probes covering encodings, the response-content-type override, POST and a stopped MinIO.
fix: Section 3, first bullet: replace the location line with: location ~ "^/media/(products/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/[0-9a-f]{16}-[0-9]{3,4}\.webp)$" (the whole regex in double quotes, because it contains braces). Add one sentence to Rollout step 3: 'The rendered file is checked with nginx -t; a regex containing { } must be quoted.'

finding: decision 3: media/ backup on every deploy
detail: The owner decision says each deploy's backup step also copies the bucket's media/ prefix. The spec applies this only in Rollout step 1, which reads 'Back up before the first start of the new image' and is one-off for this change. Documents to update item 3 mentions only 'the manual media backup' in architecture.md, without saying that the standing deploy and backup procedure changes. Risks and 'Not in this round' say 'each deploy's backup step' but point back to Rollout step 1. A later deploy, or a client fork following the deploy recipe, has no stated step that copies media/. The staff help text and the launch checklist item (section 5, item 2) are present and correct.
fix: Rollout on dev, step 1: change 'Back up before the first start of the new image:' to 'Back up before every deploy of api, starting with the first start of the new image (this is the standing deploy backup step until B9):'. Documents to update, item 3: replace '...and the manual media backup.' with '...and the deploy backup step, which from now on copies the bucket media/ prefix to a dated folder off the MinIO volume on every deploy (until the automated, scheduled backups of milestone B9). Any deploy script or runbook that has its own backup step gets the same line.'

finding: 16. nginx/compose plan (contradiction between Testing, dev probes and section 3)
detail: The dev probe list says `/media/%2e%2e/health/x` and `/media/..%2fhealth` both answer 404. nginx matches locations on the decoded and normalised URI, so these become `/health/x` and `/health`. They never reach the `/media/` locations. In the current web/nginx.conf they hit `location = /health` (API health, 200) and the `location /` SPA fallback (index.html, 200). They do not answer 404, so the check as written cannot pass. The allowlist regex itself is fine. Only the expected result is wrong.
fix: Testing, "On dev, after deploy", Listing and probes: replace `/media/%2e%2e/health/x`, `/media/..%2fhealth` ... "all answer 404" with: "`/media/%2e%2e/health/x` and `/media/..%2fhealth` are normalised by nginx to `/health/...` and never reach MinIO. They must return the same response as a direct request to that normalised path (SPA index.html or API health) and must contain no MinIO headers or XML. `/media//products/B01/x.webp` (merged slashes, name does not match the 16-hex pattern) and `/media/products/B01/x.webp?response-content-type=text/html` answer 404. A traversal that stays under `/media/` (for example `/media/products/..%2f..%2fx`) must also be 404 or normalised away."

finding: 15. Dependency details (sharp version vs metadata test)
detail: The spec pins sharp 0.33.5 exactly (section 2, Dependencies). The metadata-stripping test builds its fixture with `.withExif(...)`, `.withXmp(...)` and `.withIccProfile('p3')`. I believe `withXmp` was added to sharp after 0.33.5, in the 0.34.x line. I could not confirm this because sharp is not installed in server/node_modules. If that is right, the test fixture does not compile or run on the pinned version. Section 2 only says the implementer confirms the versions install. It does not say to confirm that the API used in the tests exists.
fix: Section 2 Dependencies paragraph, append: "The implementer confirms that every sharp API used in tests (`withExif`, `withXmp`, `withIccProfile`, `metadata().xmp`) exists in the pinned version. If `withXmp` is missing in 0.33.5, either pin the lowest 0.34.x release that has it (re-checking the linux-x64 glibc prebuilt and Node 22) or build the XMP fixture by injecting an XMP APP1 segment into the JPEG bytes in the test. The precondition assertion (input carries exif, xmp and icc) stays."

finding: 17. Web unit tests (pure functions do not cover all listed cases)
detail: The Testing section lists cases for the node-only vitest setup that no listed pure function in `web/src/domain/photos.ts` can implement. These are "the alt counter counts code points", "the upload stays disabled until the rights box is checked", "thumbnail labels contain no alt text" and "a one-photo product shows no thumbnail row". `galleryPick` returns the selected photo, not the thumbnail row. Without matching pure functions the cases can only be done in React, which has no test setup. Also, `web/src/domain/` is Agent 01's read-only reference folder (CLAUDE.md). The spec approves only the `types.ts` and `rbac.ts` edits there, not a new file.
fix: Testing, Web unit tests paragraph: extend the `photos.ts` list with `altCounter(text)` (returns code-point count, "{n}/125 karakter"), `canUpload(file, rightsConfirmed, busy)`, `thumbLabel(index, total)` (returns "Foto 2 dari 4", no alt) and `showThumbnails(product)` (false for 0 or 1 photo). Map each listed case to one of these functions. Also add to section 4 or the "Changes after review" list: "New file `web/src/domain/photos.ts` (pure functions, no React) is part of the approved change, like the `types.ts` and `rbac.ts` edits."

finding: 23. Variant-photo link and lock order (missing deadlock test)
detail: The lock order is specified correctly: product row first, then variants in sku order, matching `lockStock`. The error mapping and the 422/409 cases are in the spec. The finding's last test is not carried over: a photo delete running concurrently with an order or stock transaction on the same variants must finish without a deadlock error. The fake DB cannot show this and the dev checks do not cover it. The lock-order claim is therefore untested.
fix: Testing, "On dev, after deploy", Concurrency on the real database: append "Run a checkout (variant stock lock) and, at the same time, delete or link a photo on a product whose variants are in that cart, 20 times in parallel. Every request ends with 200, 201, 404 or 409 and none with 500 or a Postgres deadlock (40P01). Then run the existing concurrency check (12/12)."

finding: Contradiction: audit actorId rule vs audit payload table (section 2, Audit)
detail: The text says every media entry carries `actorId` inside `after` (or inside `before` when `after` is null). The table does not allow this. `PRODUCT_IMAGE_REORDERED` has before and after that are plain arrays of ids, so no actorId fits. `PRODUCT_IMAGE_ALT_CHANGED` is `{ imageId, alt }`, and `VARIANT_IMAGE_LINKED` is `{ imageId or null }`. The rule says attribution survives a staff rename, but three codes cannot meet it.
fix: Section 2, Audit table. Replace the rows with: `PRODUCT_IMAGE_REORDERED` before `{ ids: [...] }`, after `{ ids: [...], actorId }`. `PRODUCT_IMAGE_ALT_CHANGED` before `{ imageId, alt }`, after `{ imageId, alt, actorId }`. `VARIANT_IMAGE_LINKED` before `{ imageId or null }`, after `{ imageId or null, actorId }`. Keep the rule text, and add: "after is never null for a media code except where the table says null; removal carries actorId in after."

finding: Finding 33: storage seam cannot support the policy tests (d) and (e)
detail: The `ObjectStorage` interface has `ensurePublicMediaPolicy()` but no put/get policy method. The real class builds and compares the policy internally. Testing says the in-memory fake checks that the policy JSON allows only `s3:GetObject` on `media/*`, that a broader pre-existing policy is replaced, and that a differing read-back is detected. The fake has no policy methods, so it cannot show any of this. Test (e) needs `HeadBucket`, `CreateBucket` and policy calls to throw, but the spec never says the S3 client is injectable into the real class.
fix: Section 1, Storage seam. Add `putBucketPolicy(json)` and `getBucketPolicy()` to `ObjectStorage`. Make the policy builder and the compare-by-meaning check pure functions in `server/src/media/policy.ts`. `ensurePublicMediaPolicy()` composes them. Say that the real `ObjectStorage` takes the `S3Client` as a constructor argument so tests can inject a stub whose `HeadBucket`, `CreateBucket` and policy calls throw. The in-memory fake records and returns the policy so tests (d) and (e) run against it.

finding: Finding 26: catch-all /media/ 404 is not the same plain 404 as @media_404
detail: `location /media/ { return 404; }` returns nginx's default HTML 404 page with no `Cache-Control: no-store`. The matched-path failures go through `@media_404`, which sends plain text and no-store. The finding asked for a no-store 404 on the listing probes too. A 404 with no cache headers can also be cached heuristically. The dev check says a stopped MinIO answers an "empty 404", but `@media_404` returns the body "Not found", so the two statements contradict each other.
fix: Section 3, first bullet. Change the catch-all to `location /media/ { error_page 404 = @media_404; return 404; }` so every non-allowlisted path gets the same no-store, nosniff, plain-text response. In the dev checks (Testing, Listing and probes), replace "an empty 404" with "a 404 with the body `Not found`". Add: "`GET /media/` also carries `Cache-Control: no-store`."

finding: Finding 35: sharp 0.33.5 may not provide `.withXmp()`; orientation fixture method is unstated
detail: The metadata test builds its fixture with `.withXmp(...)` while the spec pins sharp 0.33.5. As far as I recall, `withXmp` arrived in a later 0.34.x release, so I could not confirm it exists in the pinned version. If it does not, the XMP precondition cannot be built and the test fails to compile. The EXIF orientation 6 fixture in the Rotation test names no creation method. The spec only says the implementer confirms the dependency versions install.
fix: Section 2, Dependencies, add: "The implementer confirms that `withExif`, `withXmp` and `withIccProfile` exist in the pinned sharp version. If `withXmp` does not, either bump the pin to the first version that has it (and update every pin statement) or build the XMP fixture by inserting an APP1 `http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/` segment into the JPEG buffer." In Testing, Rotation and widths, add: "the orientation fixture is made with `.withMetadata({ orientation: 6 })`."

finding: Contradiction: seed failure scope (Goals and section 5 vs Testing)
detail: Section 5 says `media:seed` refuses "nothing written for that product" on a hash, file or SKU mismatch, which allows other products to be written. Testing says it "refuses ... writing nothing", and Goals says it exits non-zero. Rollout step 4 says "if it fails halfway, run it again", which fits partial writes. The three statements disagree on whether validation is up-front and all-or-nothing.
fix: Section 5, `npm run media:seed` paragraph. Replace the refusal sentence with: "Before any write it validates every entry of `samples.json` (file present, `hash16` and target match the file, SKU exists on the product). If any entry fails it exits 1 and writes nothing for any product. After validation passes, products are processed one by one; a storage or database failure part-way is repaired by running the command again." Make the Testing line match.

finding: Testing gap: Playwright and success criteria need multi-photo and multi-variant products, but sample data has none
detail: Appendix A gives each product at most one photo. B01 and A01, the only multi-variant products, keep their drawings. Goals ask for variant-photo switching. The Playwright list requires thumbnail switching (which needs at least 2 photos) and variant switching (which needs a multi-variant product with linked photos). The sample seed alone makes none of these testable, and the spec does not say how the test data is created or cleaned up.
fix: Testing, On dev, Playwright bullet. Add: "The run first uploads two photos to B01 as Marketing, links them to two variants, and runs the thumbnail and variant checks. It then deletes those photos, so the demo state is unchanged. The caption check uses a seeded sample product (for example A02)."

finding: Finding 29/30: failed-save message missing from the Error messages table; "Tersimpan" channel unclear; empty-alt behaviour
detail: Section 4 says messages come from the Error messages table, but "Gagal menyimpan. Coba lagi." and "Unggah satu foto per kali." are not in it. Section 4 puts "Tersimpan" in an inline status region next to the field, and then says toasts are used for successes only, so the channel for success is unclear. Saying that an empty alt "is not sent and the default 'Foto {nama produk}' is shown" would make the field show a value that differs from the saved alt. Navigating inside the app with a failed save pending loses the failure silently, because no in-app prompt is added.
fix: Section 4, Admin. (1) Add two client-only messages to the Error messages table: "Gagal menyimpan. Coba lagi." (network or 5xx on alt save) and "Unggah satu foto per kali." (multi-file drop). (2) Replace "The toast is used for successes only" with "Alt-save success appears only in the inline status region; the Toaster is used for other successes (upload, delete, reorder)." (3) Replace "an empty value is not sent and the default is shown" with "an empty value is not sent; the field reverts to the last saved alt text and the row shows the validation message".

finding: Finding 31: "Jadikan utama" state on the row that is already main
detail: Section 4 says focus stays on that row's "Jadikan utama" button after the action, and the row is now first. Nothing says what that button does on the first row. The action is a no-op there, and a live button that does nothing is confusing. The first-row up and last-row down buttons are covered, but this button is not.
fix: Section 4, "One row per photo". Add: "On the first row, \"Jadikan utama\" uses `aria-disabled=\"true\"` and ignores the click, and its label reads \"Foto utama\". After \"Jadikan utama\" on another row, focus stays on that row's button, which is now the disabled \"Foto utama\" button, so focus is not lost."

finding: Finding 34: "10 MB" is not defined in bytes
detail: Tests require that exactly 10 MB is accepted and 10 MB plus 1 byte returns 413. nginx uses `11m`, which is MiB. The spec never says whether 10 MB is 10,000,000 or 10,485,760 bytes. The two implementations could disagree and the boundary test would be ambiguous.
fix: Section 3, "Configuration per client fork", `limits.ts` sentence. Add: "`MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024` (10 MiB, shown as \"10 MB\" in copy); nginx `client_max_body_size 11m` is 11 MiB." Use this constant in the boundary test.

finding: finding 47 (MinIO outage must not block start-up) and section 5 commands
detail: The spec says that while ready=false 'upload, delete and media:seed answer 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE'. media:seed and media:remove-samples are CLI processes with no HTTP response, and the spec does not say whether they wait for the 30 s init retry, how long they wait, or what exit code they return. An operator running them against a degraded MinIO gets undefined behaviour.
fix: Section 1, Start-up bullet, replace 'upload, delete and `media:seed` answer 503 `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`' with 'upload and delete answer 503 `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`; `media:seed` and `media:remove-samples` run the same bucket and policy init once at start, and if storage is not ready they print "Penyimpanan foto sedang tidak tersedia." with the error class, write nothing and exit with code 1'. Add a Seed test case: 'with storage not ready, both commands exit 1 and write nothing'.

finding: finding 39 (seed must not re-add removed samples) versus Risks, loss of the MinIO volume
detail: Risks says sample photos can be restored 'by deleting the orphaned sample rows and running npm run media:seed again'. Deleting those rows through the admin or through media:remove-samples writes PRODUCT_IMAGE_REMOVED, and section 5 then makes media:seed skip that product forever (and the test 'seed, remove-samples, seed again leaves zero photos' enforces it). Only a raw SQL delete, which writes no audit entry and breaks constraint 7, would work. The recovery path is therefore either impossible or unaudited.
fix: Section 5, add to the media:seed bullet: 'With `--repair-files`, media:seed re-uploads any missing WebP object of existing `source: "sample"` rows from `server/seed/media/` (checked by hash and file name), changes no row, and writes no audit entry.' In Risks (loss of the MinIO volume) replace the sample-restore sentence with: 'Sample photos are restored by restoring the media/ backup, or by `npm run media:seed -- --repair-files` for products that still have their sample rows; staff uploads can only come from the backup.' Add a Seed test: '--repair-files restores a deleted sample object and writes no row or audit entry.'

finding: finding 45 / section 3 versus dev checks (404 behaviour on /media)
detail: The dev check says that with MinIO stopped 'a request answers an empty 404', but @media_404 is specified as `return 404 "Not found"` (a plain-text body). The catch-all `location /media/ { return 404; }` has no error_page, so nginx would send its default HTML 404 page, not the plain no-store 404 that section 3 and the 'plain 404' decision promise for /media/, /media/products/ and odd paths.
fix: Section 3, first bullet: change the catch-all to `location /media/ { error_page 404 = @media_404; return 404; }` so every non-matching /media/ path gets the same plain text body, `Cache-Control: no-store` and `nosniff`. In Testing, On dev, replace 'answers an empty 404, not nginx's 502 page' with 'answers the plain-text 404 "Not found" with `Cache-Control: no-store`, not nginx's HTML 404 or 502 page', and apply the same wording to the `GET /media/` probes.

finding: finding 44 / Processing target ladder
detail: The ladder rule is ambiguous at the edges. A photo with shorter side exactly 960 gives targets 480 and 960 from the fixed ladder, then 'the shorter side becomes the largest target' adds 960 again; a shorter side of exactly 480 gives 480 twice. The file name, `sizes` array, srcset and the seed's file-name check could then contain duplicates or collide on the same key.
fix: Section 2, Processing, first bullet, append: 'The target list is de-duplicated and sorted ascending: the ladder values not larger than the shorter side, plus the shorter side itself when it is under 1600 and not already in the list (shorter side 480 gives [480]; 960 gives [480, 960]; 1200 gives [480, 960, 1200]; 1600 or more gives [480, 960, 1600]).' Add the cases 480 and 960 to the 'Rotation and widths' test.

finding: finding 42 (rights confirmation) and web unit tests
detail: The web test list requires 'the upload stays disabled until the rights box is checked' and 'the alt counter counts code points', but the node-only vitest setup can only test the pure functions in web/src/domain/photos.ts, and no function for either rule is listed. The tests cannot be written as specified.
fix: Section Testing, web unit tests: add to the photos.ts function list `canUpload(file, rightsConfirmed, busy)` (false without a file, without the box ticked, or while busy) and `altLength(text)` (code-point count using the same cleaning as the server). State that the Producs admin page uses both functions, so the tests cover the real behaviour.

finding: Contradiction (found while checking 50 and 59): nginx regex location in section 3
detail: The allowlist location `~ ^/media/(products/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/[0-9a-f]{16}-[0-9]{3,4}\.webp)$` contains `{16}` and `{3,4}` unquoted. nginx reads an unquoted `{` in a directive argument as the start of a block, so `nginx -t` fails with a parse error ('directive has no opening {' or 'unexpected {'). Rollout step 3 would then block the web deploy. Quantifiers in a regex location must be inside quotes.
fix: Section 3, first bullet: write the location with the regex in double quotes, for example `location ~ "^/media/(products/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/[0-9a-f]{16}-[0-9]{3,4}\.webp)$" { ... }`, and add the sentence: 'The regex is quoted because it contains braces; nginx refuses an unquoted `{`.' Also add a Rollout step 3 expectation that the rendered `/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf` still has the quoted regex after envsubst (the filter leaves `$` and braces alone).

finding: 54 Metadata, content-type and credit-link tests
detail: Content type (putObject with image/webp, test f) and the metadata test (precondition on exif, xmp, icc, RIFF chunk FourCC check) are resolved. The finding's third part, the safe source link rule, is now in section 4 (https:// only, target and rel) but the Testing section has no test for it and nothing says the API checks the scheme when a sample row is written. fix: Testing, web unit tests paragraph: add a pure function `safeSourceLink(url)` to `web/src/domain/photos.ts` (returns the URL only when it starts with `https://`, otherwise null) and the case: 'a sourceUrl of `javascript:alert(1)`, `http://example.com` or an empty value gives no anchor and is shown as plain text; an `https://` value gives an anchor with target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer"'. Section 5, `media:seed` paragraph: add 'It refuses (exit code 1) a sample whose licence URL or source URL does not start with https://.' and add the matching case to the Seed test bullet.

finding: Contradiction: Testing 'variant switching' versus Appendix A
detail: Testing (Playwright on dev) and Goals require variant switching to be verified, but Appendix A gives sample photos to no multi-variant product: B01 and A01 (the only products with more than one variant, section 4 'Foto per varian') both keep their drawings, so samples.json will have no variant SKUs and no variant-linked photo exists on dev after media:seed. The Playwright check cannot run as written, and gallery rules (b) to (e) are never exercised end to end.

Alternatively add to the Goals line 44 that variant switching is verified on an uploaded photo, not a sample.

finding: 57 sizes table: Account rows labels
detail: The sizes values now match the real layouts (verified against Account.tsx: w-14 at line 90 and a 72 px grid column at line 199), but the table labels them 'Account rows with `w-14`' and 'Account saved-products rows (72 px column)', and the text says 'the implementer matches the last two rows against Account.tsx'. (or state the opposite if the owner wants the variant photo there).

finding: 65. Alt text for sample photos is accurate-by-assumption
detail: Section 5 now limits sample alt text to what is visible, and the seed test checks that no unit-bearing number appears. The original fix also required Appendix A to list the proposed alt text next to each candidate so the owner approves it with the photo. Section 5 says 'Alt text is approved with the photo', but the Appendix A table has no alt-text column and no proposed text for any of the five candidate photos (B07, B05, B06, A02, A04, A03). fix: In 'Appendix A: candidate demo photos', add a column 'Proposed alt text (Bahasa, visible content only, no specifications)' after 'Check by eye before download', with one proposal per chosen photo. Example values: B07 'Kabel USB-C dengan ikatan kabel di atas latar polos'; B05 'Konektor Lightning dari dekat di atas latar putih'; B06 'Konektor HDMI dari dekat di atas latar putih'; A02 'Toples krim putih di atas permukaan kayu dengan daun'; A04 'Tabung lembut putih dan hitam di atas latar polos'; A03 'Botol serum polos di atas latar putih, difoto dari atas'. Leave the cell empty on the 'Tetap gambar' rows.
